name: HCA Healthcare UK
testimonial: "What does it really feel like to be cared for in one of our hospitals? That was the question at the heart of a new suite of films we’ve created at HCA UK. … A huge thank you too to our production partners … for bringing that vision to life with such sensitivity, professionalism and care. A project I am immensely proud of and one that reminds me that the best healthcare marketing starts with understanding what matters to patients."
